heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 119–60, div. H, title LXXXIV, § 8414, Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1915

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 100–330, § 6, June 7, 1988, 102 Stat. 594; Pub. L. 108–219, title IV, § 402, Apr. 13, 2004, 118 Stat. 617, created certain exceptions to prohibitions under section 973c of this title and licensing requirements under section 973g of this title.
